description:
לאתר אלביט מערכות בנוף הגליל דרוש.ה סטודנט.ית להנדסת מכונות שנה שנייה להצטרפות למחלקת ההנדסה והמו"פ
במסגרת התפקיד תהיה לך הזדמנות להשתלב בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת, לקחת חלק בפעילויות פיתוח והנדסה ולצבור ניסיון מקצועי משמעותי בארגון ביטחוני מוביל
במסגרת התפקיד :
סיוע בפעילויות מחלקת ההנדסה והמו"פ
עבודה מול ממשקים מקצועיים בתחום הפיתוח וההנדסה
השתלבות בפרויקטים הנדסיים ומשימות שוטפות במחלקה
עבודה בהיקף של 2–3 ימים בשבוע

דרישות:
סטודנט.ית שנה שנייה להנדסת מכונות
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה בקריאה וכתיבה
יכולת קריאה והבנת שרטוטים
ניסיון ב-SolidWorks - יתרון
יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודה בצוות
סדר וארגון ויכולת למידה גבוהה
יש לצרף גיליון ציונים להגשת המועמדות
*הפניה מיועדת לנשים וגברים כאחד
**רק פניות מתאימות יענו

About this role

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe.

You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About The Role

We are looking for a student for a temporary, part-time position covering maternity leave.

The role involves conducting telephone sales calls and managing leads generated through social media marketing campaigns.

Requirements

Currently enrolled in an academic program.

Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Availability to work part-time on 3–4 days per week.

Previous telephone sales experience is an advantage.

Strong customer service orientation and ability to work effectively in a team.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Benefits & Compensation

MiniMed offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package

At MiniMed, we put people first. A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values: We recognize their contributions.

They share in the success they help create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every stage of your career and life.

About MiniMed

We want to make every day a better day for people living with diabetes.

Our team of creative innovators around the globe share a passion for finding the simplest solutions to the problems that people with diabetes face on a daily basis.

For more than 40 years, we've been redefining what's possible, from intelligent dosing systems designed for real life to predictive insights that stay a step ahead, and we're dedicated to continuing to support our customers through every step of their journey — meeting them where and how they need it.

About the Role:

GNY, a leading law firm in Israel is seeking talented and enthusiastic engineers to join our growing Intellectual Property (IP) team as a Trainee Patent Attorney, working alongside patent attorneys and attorneys at law.

This is a unique opportunity to apply your engineering knowledge in a rewarding and stimulating legal environment.

What You’ll Do:
• Assist in various
IP projects, gaining practical experience in engineering principles
Learn about all aspects of IP practice, including:
Patent, design, and trademark prosecution
Copyright matters
Legal opinions and due diligence
IP litigation
Interact with innovative individuals and sophisticated companies shaping our future
Train under professionally skilled and academically renowned

IP practitioners

Requirements:
BSc degree (minimum), preferably in:
Mechanical Engineering
Aeronautical Engineering
Electrical Engineering
Physics
Academic Excellence:
Minimum average score of 80 from a leading university
College graduates: minimum average score of 87
Excellent command of written and spoken English and Hebrew
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to conceptualize complex matters
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Positive attitude towards teamwork
What We’re Looking For:
Passion for technology and innovation
Strong interest in intellectual property law
Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, multifaceted work environment
Keen attention to detail
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
Why Join Us:
Gain unique experience at the intersection of technology and law
Work on cutting-edge innovations across various industries
Develop a diverse skill set applicable to both technical and legal fields
Opportunity for professional growth and potential career transition into IP law
Qualified candidates, please submit your resume, academic transcripts, and a cover letter explaining your interest in IP
